description: [Ncloud Storage] ⚠️ Destructive: Delete an object from a Ncloud Storage bucket (DELETE /{key}). In a versioning-enabled bucket, omitting versionId only adds a delete marker (the versions stay and keep billing); pass versionId to permanently remove one version. bypassGovernanceRetention=true is needed for objects under GOVERNANCE retention. Set confirm=true to execute.

bucketName.description: Name of the Ncloud Storage bucket

bypassGovernanceRetention.description: Send x-amz-bypass-governance-retention: true to delete an object locked in GOVERNANCE mode (requires the bypass permission)

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute the destructive operation

versionId.description: Version ID to delete permanently. Omit to delete the current version (adds a delete marker on versioned buckets)

name: ncloud_ncs_delete_object
